headings.usage: Use for all headlines, large hero text, and section titles. Apply tracking-tighter for larger sizes.

body.usage: Use for all paragraph text, small labels, and buttons. Clean, geometric, and readable.

textures.grain: Apply a very subtle SVG noise/grain overlay (opacity 2-3%) to the entire app wrapper to give it a tactile, editorial paper feel.

grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: Use asymmetric layouts. For 'Our World' or 'Product Categories', use a CSS grid with varying row/col spans to avoid a basic uniform grid. Leave intentional negative space.

motion.page_transitions: Framer Motion layout animations. Fade out/in on route change.
motion.scroll_reveals: Framer Motion `whileInView`. Elements should subtly fade and drift up (translateY from 20px) on scroll.
motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal for 'VANALUME' and 'Composed Living'. Use Framer Motion staggerChildren with hidden overflow and y-axis translation.
motion.hover_effects: Image zoom inside a static clipped frame (overflow-hidden). Buttons should have an elegant background fill or arrow translation on hover. Do not use bouncing or jittery hover effects.
motion.particles: Consider subtle floating particles (using Framer Motion or lightweight Canvas) in the hero or 'Our Philosophy' section to mimic aroma/fragrance in the air.

components.navbar: Glassmorphism header: `backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F8F6F2]/75 border-b border-[#2B2823]/10`. MUST NOT be fully transparent.
components.buttons: Outlined button style: `border border-[#2B2823] text-[#2B2823] px-8 py-3 rounded-full hover:bg-[#2B2823] hover:text-[#F8F6F2] transition-colors duration-300`.
components.cards: Cardless or flat minimal cards. No generic floating white boxes with drop shadows. Use subtle borders or pure image + text lockups.
components.form_inputs: Minimalist inputs: `border-b border-[#2B2823]/30 bg-transparent focus:border-[#2B2823] outline-none py-2 transition-colors`. No bulky input boxes.
components.marquee: Slow, smooth horizontal scrolling text for fragrance strips using `react-fast-marquee`. Low contrast colors (e.g., warm beige background, charcoal text).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against the warm off-white and charcoal backgrounds meets WCAG AA standards.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for Lenis and Framer Motion.
accessibility.aria: Include aria-labels on icon buttons and proper alt text for all mood and product imagery.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="explore-collections-button"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a 5-page React application (Home, Collections, Our Philosophy, Founder Story, Contact) using React Router.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for marketing-style layouts instead of Shadcn cards to allow for organic, overlapping, asymmetrical design.
Implement Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling globally.
Use Framer Motion for line-by-line text reveals in heroes, scroll-triggered fade-up sections, and subtle image zoom on hover inside containers.
Ensure the NavBar has a glassmorphism effect (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F8F6F2]/75) and sticky positioning. Do NOT make it completely transparent.
Typography: Use Cormorant Garamond for headings and Manrope for body text. Add these fonts via Google Fonts in index.html.
Color Palette: Map the provided colors in tailwind.config.js and use them strictly.
Create the 'Our World' and 'Collections' sections using deliberate photography treatment—clipped frames with slow scale-in hover effects.
Implement a smooth horizontal Marquee for the fragrance strip using react-fast-marquee.
In the Contact page, use native styled inputs or Shadcn inputs customized to match the minimal aesthetic (bottom border only, no bounding box).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and generous spacing (2-3x normal).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the CSS file.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Always use the provided image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Use `sonner` for toast notifications where necessary.
